--color-tag-disabled-bg: Disabled tag pill fill — gray-150 is a primitive and never flips, so dark mode showed light-gray text on a light-gray pill (1.3:1).
--color-tag-disabled-text: Disabled tag label — pairs >=4.5:1 with disabled-bg in every theme.
--color-background-cards: Dark card surface — Figma dark mode still exports white (unset); white card + light text.primary title is unreadable. Remove once Figma carries a real dark value.
